picks.title: Brown Introduces Legislation to Require Labels on AI-Generated Campaign Content
picks.excerpt: Rep. Shontel Brown introduced the Securing Elections from AI Deception Act to bar using AI to deprive or defraud people of the right to vote and to require disclaimers on AI-generated campaign content.
picks.rationale: A primary document: a newly introduced federal bill that would require disclaimers on AI-generated campaign content, which falls directly on anyone producing political media with AI. The copy should call it an introduced bill, not a law, and attribute its aims to the sponsor.

picks.title: Judge rejects Trump's claim EPA can dismiss data center pollution lawsuits
picks.excerpt: A federal court ruled the Trump administration's EPA cannot unilaterally dismiss the pollution lawsuit over SpaceXAI's (xAI) Memphis-area AI data center turbines.
picks.rationale: A new court ruling: the pollution suit over the xAI Memphis data center turbines goes ahead despite the EPA's move to dismiss it. It is a concrete decision on how AI data centers are sited and powered. Use neutral wording for the headline (drop Ars's 'wild') and attribute the EPA's position to the administration.

picks.title: New UN initiative will aim to tackle the military uses of AI
picks.excerpt: The UN Institute for Disarmament Research (UNIDIR) launches the first international forum on military uses of AI this Thursday.
picks.rationale: An official multilateral launch: UNIDIR's first international forum on military AI. It covers the military-AI governance angle and is distinct from the 10-21 card on the UNGA co-chairs for the AI Governance Dialogue, which is a different body and process.

picks.title: Publishers want Brussels and London to stop Meta's new AI terms
picks.excerpt: Publishers asked the European Commission and UK CMA to act against Meta's new AI training terms; the Commission says Meta must comply with EU law and the CMA has called the company in to explain.
picks.rationale: Regulators have acted: the UK CMA called Meta in over its AI-training terms, and the Commission has stated its position. This is a step past the corporate terms change itself, and it touches how platform data can feed AI training. Attribute the complaint to the publishers and do not present it as an enforcement decision.

picks.title: [AI픽] "전기는 국가망에서 받으라더니"…AI 데이터센터 새 규제 논란
picks.excerpt: 정부가 연내 도입을 추진하는 AI 데이터센터 전용 그리드코드(전력망 접속 규칙)를 두고 투자 현장에서 논란이 일고 있다.
picks.rationale: Korea plans to introduce a grid code for AI data centers within the year, setting rules for how they connect to the national grid. That directly changes the economics of building AI infrastructure in Korea, and it adds a non-US/EU jurisdiction. The copy should present it as a planned rule, attribute the criticism to industry, and not pass judgement on the policy.
